c5b86e593b: Genoryn Krypton (GNR) FAQ: Quantum Security, Mining, Swaps
fd31011f1a: Questions about Genoryn Krypton, answered honestly.
871e7f69b5: <0>Genoryn Krypton (GNR)</0> is a quantum-resistant, private-by-default proof-of-work cryptocurrency with Bitcoin's monetary design. Here is what people ask most: what it is, why quantum resistance matters, how to mine it and how to get it.
fa3cc61e43: Genoryn Krypton, ticker GNR, is a quantum-resistant, private-by-default proof-of-work cryptocurrency with Bitcoin's monetary design: at most 21,000,000 coins, halvings about every four years, mining and a fair launch with no premine. Coins are protected by hash-based zk-STARK proofs instead of elliptic curves, and every transfer is shielded. <0>More about it</0>.
b514c0c3a5: Mainnet started on 3 November 2026. Its genesis block commits to the hash of Bitcoin block 974,438, the newest Bitcoin block at that moment, so no GNR could be mined earlier, not even by its author.
0c050dea07: How many GNR will ever exist?
a9721147b4: At most 21,000,000 GNR, enforced by every node. A block is found about every 60 seconds and pays 5 GNR; the reward halves every 2,100,000 blocks, about every four years.
6129277b53: The smallest unit of GNR: 1 GNR = 100,000,000 krypton, as a satoshi is to a bitcoin.
60243fc41d: Is it a fork of Bitcoin, or a token on another chain?
e21c36eed8: Neither. It is an independent layer-1 network with its own code, written in Rust, and its own chain. It follows Bitcoin's monetary rules and trades with bitcoin through atomic swaps, but shares no code or coins with it.
57a114c65b: Who created it, and who controls it?
1d812d83a9: It was created by the pseudonymous Zarazi Sokani, whose identity will never be revealed. No company, foundation or person controls the protocol: rules change only when the people who run nodes choose to run new software.
882e87394f: Yes. The node, miner, wallets and swap engine are open source under MIT or Apache-2.0 at <0>github.com/genoryn/genoryn</0>.
492bb8b49c: Why are quantum computers a threat to cryptocurrencies?
c48a9ff19a: Almost every cryptocurrency protects coins with elliptic-curve signatures. A large enough quantum computer running Shor's algorithm could compute a private key from its public key and spend other people's coins. It could also decrypt private transactions that were recorded years earlier. <0>The full explanation</0>.
de01679362: No elliptic curve protects coins or privacy. Spending is a zk-STARK proof over hash functions, payment data is encrypted with hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-1024 (NIST FIPS 203), peers connect over X25519 + ML-KEM-768, and releases are signed with ML-DSA-87 and SLH-DSA (FIPS 204 and 205). Shor's algorithm breaks none of these.
9da46d8b4d: Not today. Bitcoin's coins are guarded by ECDSA and Schnorr signatures on the secp256k1 curve, which Shor's algorithm breaks. Coins whose public key is already visible on chain (early pay-to-public-key outputs, reused addresses, Taproot outputs) are the most exposed. No quantum computer can do this yet, and Bitcoin's developers are discussing post-quantum upgrades.
75db53587e: What does "harvest now, decrypt later" mean?
c1c455eb62: Encrypted data recorded today can be stored and decrypted once a quantum computer exists. For a privacy coin that relies on elliptic curves this means past transactions could be exposed later, and no upgrade can undo it. GNR encrypts payment data with post-quantum ML-KEM from its first block.
1e375f8057: Do quantum computers break hash functions or mining?
be69c5946b: No. Grover's algorithm gives at most a quadratic speed-up against hashes, so a 256-bit hash keeps a 128-bit security margin. Proof of work adjusts its difficulty to whatever hardware mines.
af4f39b13e: Every transfer is shielded: amounts, senders, recipients and memos are hidden for everyone, always. There is no transparent mode. Mining payouts are public per miner, as on every chain; mine to a separate wallet to keep them unlinked.
7360987fcb: No. A balance can be computed only by a wallet that holds the keys.
2244c2e37e: Can I prove that I paid someone?
d676a9e2bc: Yes. The wallet creates a payment proof for one payment, which shows that payment to whoever you give it to and reveals nothing else.
a8f054dc51: Install the wallet, create a wallet, open the Mining tab, choose your GPU or CPU and press Start mining. No account, no pool and no configuration files are needed. <0>Mining guide</0>.
8bfbb19902: A GPU is roughly 40 to 50 times faster: an RTX 5090 does about 75 MH/s and a 24-core CPU about 1.4 MH/s. NVIDIA cards mine with CUDA, AMD and Intel cards with OpenCL. CPUs work too, and the miner can cap their usage.
232ff5625f: Do I need a mining pool?
c22a946ea0: No. Every block's reward is shared among all miners by the work they did: about 32 shares per block each earn an equal slice. With 1 % of the hashrate you earn about 1 % of the rewards, with no pool operator in between.
48b52e5bd9: Every 360 blocks, about every six hours, each miner receives one payout, which can be spent 100 blocks later.
cfda13f7bd: Was there a premine, a presale or a developer fee?
362e66ca59: No. The genesis block issues nothing, there was no presale, and every block pays miners only, under the same schedule since block 1.
1ff2940ec4: In the wallet's Swap tab, with bitcoin, through an atomic swap with another person: take a sell offer or publish a buy offer. There is no exchange, no account and no custody. <0>How to get GNR</0>.
61eff42612: Is GNR listed on an exchange?
448724d72b: No. GNR is earned by mining or exchanged with bitcoin directly between wallets.
ae5e14360e: Only from completed swaps of the last 72 hours whose bitcoin the board found on the Bitcoin chain: the market price is where half of that bitcoin changed hands below and half above (a volume-weighted median). Offers and swaps in progress never move it. <0>Live market</0>.
30671c246e: Bitcoin's coins are guarded by elliptic-curve signatures, which a large quantum computer could break. A swap moves value into a system guarded by hash-based proofs, directly from your own wallet.
05e02a177c: Can someone offer GNR they do not have?
bc809999bc: No. A sell offer is listed only after its GNR is set aside in a note of its own and the offer board has checked a zero-knowledge proof that the seller can spend it. The board takes the offer down the moment that GNR moves, and the same GNR cannot back two offers. <0>The rules of an offer</0>.
78704d146d: Why is my GNR held after I cancel a sell offer?
1c95a272eb: Publishing a sell offer commits its GNR for 7 days, so that offers are made in earnest. Within that time the GNR can be sold or put into another sell offer at once, but not sent, also after you cancel or the offer runs its time. It can be sent again 7 days after the day you published.
5eaa777d09: Can someone take my sell offer and never pay?
25211f0cdc: Not if the offer is for buyers whose bitcoin is already deposited, which is the default from 1.0.43: your wallet checks on the Bitcoin chain that the buyer's bitcoin is waiting before it locks any GNR, and the buyer's wallet pays by itself. If you open an offer to every buyer, one who never pays can keep your GNR locked until its refund block, about 21 hours; your wallet locks for at most two such buyers at a time.
82179a3716: My swap says the GNR is locked and nothing happens. Is it stuck?
db708f5c26: No. When a buyer takes a sell offer, the seller's GNR is locked on chain for them. If the buyer never pays, nobody can open that lock before its refund block, about 21 hours later; then the seller's wallet takes the GNR back by itself. The swap card shows that block and how long it is. Nothing is lost and nothing needs doing, except keeping the wallet running at that time.
984fce770f: Where is the bitcoin of a buy offer?
1a82818962: At an address of the buyer's own wallet. A bitcoin contract has to name the seller's key and the hash of the seller's secret, and neither exists before a seller takes the offer, so the bitcoin cannot wait in the contract. Instead the buyer pays it to an address only their wallet has the key of; the offer board checks on the Bitcoin chain that it is there and marks the offer. When a seller's GNR is locked and confirmed, the wallet pays the contract by itself. If nobody sells, it sends the bitcoin back. <0>The rules of an offer</0>.
9a57afc405: I opened the same wallet on two computers. Why does only one show my swap?
e590b6257a: A swap is run by the wallet that started it, and its record is in that wallet's own file, not on the chain. The other computer shows your balance and the GNR that is locked in the swap, with the block at which it returns, but not the swap's progress. Run the offers and swaps of one wallet on one computer.
5ca5641748: Both sides lock their coins under the same hash lock with a time lock. The seller's GNR is locked on chain before the buyer pays, taking the bitcoin reveals the secret that releases the GNR, and if anyone stops, both sides are refunded after the time locks.
8615558686: Which systems does the wallet run on?
f153516c32: Windows 10 and 11 (x64) and Linux (Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13 or newer). Wallets for Android, iOS and macOS are in development. <0>Download</0>.
9af094fc2e: No. The light wallet verifies the chain itself with proofs of work and Merkle Mountain Range proofs, and checks every block it reads. A full node is optional.
f4e4cddbbc: How do I back up my wallet?
41ad0a0933: Write down the 24-word recovery phrase with its numbers when you create the wallet. The phrase restores the wallet on any computer. Nobody can recover coins without the phrase, or the wallet file and its password.
ff57193835: A small fee paid to miners, about 0.00003 GNR when the network is not busy.
f0822bcfed: How do I know a download is genuine?
5cdad7acf5: Every release publishes SHA256SUMS signed with the project's hybrid post-quantum release key (ML-DSA-87 + SLH-DSA). The wallet checks that signature before it installs an update.
2d42bd3c69: A planned feature, not live yet: stablecoins and other tokens that anyone will be able to deploy on Genoryn Krypton, as private and quantum-safe as GNR, with everything an issuer may do declared before the token exists. <0>The plan</0>.
bcd3a7026c: Can I deploy or buy a token today?
3adbca8bbd: No. No token exists on Genoryn Krypton today. Tokens will be turned on at a block height announced with a future release.
38f17755d9: It has had an internal audit and a privately reported external review, whose findings are fixed. A full independent audit has not been done yet; the zk-STARK spend circuit and the consensus code are original work and should be reviewed before significant value is trusted to them.

5d0f228434: Genoryn Krypton is a new chain with different cryptography, started from block 1 with no premine. Balances of the earlier Mainnet 1.0 are not migrated; see the <0>published policy</0>.
